# Remember Me v1.1.3 Beta — 四平台联合发布草案 / Unified release draft

状态：候选准备，未公开发布。四平台必须来自同一完整源码提交；旧版验收仅作为基线，不能替代本版本构建结果。

本版本统一提供 Linux x86_64 AppImage、Windows x64 Setup.exe、macOS Apple Silicon ARM64 DMG 和 Docker GHCR 1.1.3。macOS 包含正式品牌图标及固定离线依赖与 BGE-M3 模型。保留现有安装与数据目录规则，不自动迁移数据。

升级前正常停止服务并备份完整数据目录，验证安装包 SHA256。沿用各平台[安装指南](../../installation/)。本版本为 Pre-release，Docker 不推进 latest。v1.1.2 Tag、Release 和资产保留不变。

This Beta provides Linux x86_64 AppImage, Windows x64 Setup.exe, macOS Apple Silicon ARM64 DMG and Docker GHCR 1.1.3 from one reviewed source commit. The macOS package includes the official brand icon and pinned offline dependencies and BGE-M3 model. Existing installation and data-directory rules remain applicable.

Stop normally and back up the complete data directory before upgrading. Verify package SHA256 and follow the existing installation guides. This is a Pre-release; Docker latest must remain unchanged. Existing v1.1.2 tags, release and assets are preserved.

公开发布前必须补齐：统一提交、三安装包文件名/大小/SHA256、Docker digest、四平台 CI 链接及回归报告。真实 Mac 浏览器下载、Finder 安装、Gatekeeper 首次打开与图标视觉验收未完成时为 NO-GO。

Before publication: record the unified commit, package names/sizes/SHA256, Docker digest, CI evidence and regression results. Real Mac browser download, Finder installation, first Gatekeeper opening and visual icon acceptance remain mandatory blockers.
